title: Read-only safe mode disables Block with the usual reason
steps: Launch with -UseFakeGmail and OPENHUMAN_SAFE_MODE=read-only (fake mail only), open the Inbox
Open Cmd-K and look at Block sender and Block domain; press Option-Command-B on a conversation
expected: Block sender and Block domain are disabled in Cmd-K and the menu, and the key shows the read-only message once and changes nothing. Settings > Blocked shows the list but its Block, Unblock and choice controls are disabled with a read-only line; Go to Blocked still opens the page. There is no Also block in Gmail option anywhere.
